parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a thin HTTP controller in the infrastructure layer. It defines the transport request body shapes (StartBody, SeatsBody, CancelBody). Each of its methods unpacks the body and passes the values straight to an application use case: create calls StartSubscription.execute, resize calls ChangeSeats.execute, and cancel calls CancelSubscription.execute. It has no business rules (no seat limits, plan checks or cancellation policy), no persistence and no domain logic. Turning requests into use-case calls is a normal infrastructure/transport job, so the file fits its declared layer.
